questions.question: An article was marked at Rs. x and sold at a discount of (x - 40)%. If the customer paid Rs. (x - 32), then find the marked priced of the article
questions.solution:
**Given:**

MP of the article = Rs. x

Discount % = (x - 40)%

SP of the articles = Rs. (x - 32)

**Formula:**

SP = MP × (100 - Discount%)/100

**Calculation**

According to the question

(x - 32) = x × (100 - x + 40)/100

⇒ x - 32 = x × (140 - x)/100

⇒ 100x - 3200 = 140x - x²

⇒ x² - 40x - 3200 = 0

⇒ x² - 80x + 40x - 3200 = 0

⇒ x (x - 80) + 40 (x - 80) = 0

⇒ (x - 80) (x + 40) = 0

Taking,

⇒ (x - 80) = 0

⇒ x = 80

∴ Marked price of the article is 80.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

We can go with the options test, where only option D satisfies,

If MP is x = 80, then the discount will be (80 - 40)% = 40%

So, SP will be 80 × 60/100 = (80 - 32) [ according to the question ]

⇒ 48 = 48 which satisfies the question

questions.question: In a circle, PQ and RS are two diameters that are perpendicular to each other. Find the length of the chord PR.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

PQ and RS are two diameters that are perpendicular to each other.

**Formula:**

(Hypotenuse)² = (Base)² + (Perpendicular)²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67c4240712af2a82469847bf85e979bd2bbe56512fe323d9aa3bce0424bfd982.png] 

Let O is the center of the circle and r is the radius of the circle. 

∴ PQ = RS = 2r

In right angle ΔROP

⇒ (PR)² = (OR)² + (OP)²

⇒ (PR)² = r² + r²

⇒ (PR)² = 2r²

⇒ PR = √2 r

⇒ PR = √2 r × (√2/√2)

⇒ PR = 2r/√2

∴ PR = PQ/√2

questions.question: If sin θ - cos θ = (7)/(17), then find the value of sin θ + cos θ.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sin θ - cos θ = 7/17

**Formula:**

(sin θ + cos θ)² + (sin θ - cos θ)² = 2

**Calculation:**

(sin θ + cos θ)2 + (sin θ - cos θ)2 = 2

⇒ (sin θ + cos θ)2 + (7/17)2 = 2

⇒ (sin θ + cos θ)2 + (49/289) = 2

⇒ (sin θ + cos θ)2 = 2 - (49/289)

⇒ (sin θ + cos θ)2 = 529/289

⇒ (sin θ + cos θ) = √529/289

∴ sin θ + cos θ = 23/17

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Concept used:**

Asin θ + Bcos θ = C then the value of 

⇒ Bsin θ - Acos θ = √(A² + B² - C²)

**Calculation:**

⇒ sin θ - cos θ = 7/17 [ here A = 1 & B = 1 ]

So, sin θ + cos θ = √{1² + 1² - (7/17)²}

⇒ sin θ + cos θ = √2 - 49/289

⇒ sin θ + cos θ = √529/289 = 23/17

questions.question: If in any triangle, the angles are in the ratio of 1 : 2: 1, then what will be the ratio of its sides?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of angles of a triangle = 1 : 2 : 1

**Formula:**

Sum of all three angles of a triangle = 180°

If N is divided into a : b, then

First part = N × a/(a + b)

Second part = N × b/(a + b)

**Calculation:**

Ratio of angles of a triangle = x : 2x : x

According to the question

x + 2x + x = 180°

⇒ 4x = 180°

⇒ x = 180°/4

⇒ x = 45°

⇒ 2x = 45° × 2

⇒ 2x = 90°

Now we can say triangle is a right angled triangle.

Triangle has two equal angles so, triangle has two equal side.

See figure, ΔABC is a right angled triangle

Let AB = BC = a cm, then

(AC)² = (AB)² + (BC)²

⇒ (AC)² = a² + a²

⇒ (AC)² = 2a²

⇒ AC = √2 a

∴ Ratio of AB : AC : BC = a : √2 a : a = 1 : √2 : 1

questions.question: Sachin scored 120 runs, which included 6 boundaries and 4 sixes. What percentage of his total score did he make by running between the wickets?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sachin scored = 120 runs

Number of boundaries = 6

Number of sixes = 4

**Formula:**

x as a percentage y = (x/y) × 100

**Calculation:**

Number of runs score made by running between the wickets = 120 - 4 × 6 - 6 × 4 = 120 - 48 = 72

∴ Required percentage = (72/120) × 100 = 60%

questions.question: The average of 5 consecutive odd numbers is 75. By adding which number, will the average become 76?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 5 consecutive odd number = 75

**Formula:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of all observations

**Calculation:**

Sum of 5 consecutive odd numbers = 75 × 5 = 375

Average of 6 numbers = 76

Sum of all 6 numbers = 76 × 6 = 456

Let the 6th number be x

According to the question

x + 375 = 456

⇒ x = 456 - 375

⇒ x = 81

∴ The 6th number is 81.

questions.question: The perimeter and length of a rectangle are in the ratio of 8 : 1, and the area of the rectangle is 1323 cm². Find the length of the rectangle.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of perimeter and length of a rectangle = 8 : 1

Area of rectangle = 1323 cm²

**Formula:**

Perimeter of the rectangle = 2 (length + breadth)

Area of the rectangle = Length × Breadth

**Calculation:**

Ratio of perimeter and length of a rectangle = 8x : x

Let length = x, then

2 × (x + breadth) = 8x

⇒ x + breadth = 4x

⇒ breadth = 4x - x

⇒ breadth = 3x

Area of the rectangle = 1323

⇒ x × 3x = 1323

⇒ x² = 1323/3

⇒ x² = 441

⇒ x = √441

⇒ x = 21

**∴ Length of rectangle is 21 cm.**

questions.question: Ramu works 4 times as fast as Somu. If Somu can complete a work in 20 days independently, then the number of days in which Ramu and Somu together can complete the work is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ramu works 4 times as fast as Somu.

Somu can complete a work in = 20 days

**Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let efficiency of Somu be 1 unit/day

Efficiency of Ramu = 4 unit/day

Total work = 1 × 20 = 20 unit

∴ Time taken by Ramu and Somu to complete the same work = 20/(4 + 1) = 4 days
